ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Title.helper: Enter the title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Description.helper: Enter the text for description. Use short paragraphs so it is easy to read.

Image.helper: Ideally use a 600x400 aspect ratio image.

FilePath.helper: Choose the image or file to use for file path. Use a clear file that fits this content.

Instructions.helper: Enter the text for instructions. Use short paragraphs so it is easy to read.

Materials.helper: Add and arrange the items used for materials. Remove any item you do not need.
